title: Unsupervised learning guides experimental superalloy design
summary: A gradient-boosted regressor and unsupervised sampling workflow guided fabrication and differential-scanning-calorimetry measurements of nine superalloys selected outside the initial training compositions. Three alloys had gamma-prime solvus temperatures about 52 °C above the relevant comparators. This is a phase-solvus result, not a blade service-temperature or engine-performance result.
ai_technology: Gradient-boosting regression; t-SNE sampling; SHAP analysis

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broad deployment are not established by this review.
evidence.ai_role: Supervised prediction is combined with unsupervised extrapolation, interpretability and composition similarity to select alloys for synthesis and measurement.
